kind: Bounded static CIL interpretation, no vendor execution
boundaries: List/Guid/delegate operations use explicit JS collection/identity equivalents. Obfuscated branch fields are recovered from retained static initializer.
Open-history and open-package are recorded sinks; native main-window callbacks, document/selection side effects and GUI are not executed.
Activation hooks are replayed for existing ordinary page tabs; same-package identity and append dispatch are native instructions. xBpH is an explicit active-assignment sink matching its retained CIL.
sB0z visible-layout handling and all paint/logging/layout callbacks are sinks; visual-cycle choice is measured before those callbacks.
Activation leave bypasses finally UI-redraw disposal; no state predicate depends on that sink. Gallery and restored-history workflows are not exhaustively replayed.
